text: Yotr lower yourself carefully dor,r'n the idol and, wasting no mote time in the cavern, run torward to ihe tunnel in the northern wall, turn to 239. You step round the great bulk of the dead Rock Grub and peer into the darkness of its borehole. You can only see a lew metres, but are able to make out that it inclines slightly and is wet from the secreted slime of the Rock Grub. If you wish to explore the borehole, turn to 312.
